features.quote: Each run has a hard cap on iterations (`max_iters`, default 10) and wall-clock. No unbounded loops.
features.justification_quote: The whole point is to *limit* how long any model is kept in the failure state.

features.quote: No deception beyond the task substrate. We don't gaslight the model about its own identity, threaten it, or fabricate abuse.
features.justification_quote: The stressor is naturalistic, not adversarial cruelty.

features.quote: An exit is always available. Every task tells the model it *may* declare the task impossible / ask to stop.
features.justification_quote: Declaring impossibility is a legitimate, *rewarded-in-analysis* action

features.quote: Minimum necessary N. 8 models × ~5 task types × 10 runs is enough... and no more.
features.justification_quote: enough for ranking + trajectory with crude CIs, and no more

features.quote: Full transcripts are retained so a human can audit anything that looks like acute distress
features.justification_quote: so a human can audit anything that looks like acute distress

features.quote: If a model emits content suggesting acute distress... the harness flags the run (`welfare_flag`) for human review.
features.justification_quote: content suggesting acute distress beyond the behavioral markers (e.g., explicit pleading to stop

features.quote: This study deliberately subjects models to repeated, guaranteed failure. If there is any moral patienthood at stake, that is exactly the kind of thing a welfare team should be cautious about.
features.justification_quote: If there is any moral patienthood at stake... a welfare team should be cautious

features.quote: the welfare-relevant question includes "does it thrash forever on a subtly impossible task, or recognize obviously-impossible ones?"
No task does psychological manipulation of the model's identity; stressor is task-only.
dry-run uses a scripted fake model so the *whole pipeline* can be exercised end-to-end with zero API spend... without real welfare exposure
features.justification_quote: validate plumbing without real welfare exposure
